description: This file generates a web page for managing test case versions related to a test plan within the TestLink testing management system. It initializes page parameters, checks user rights, fetches test case data, builds display info, and renders the output with a Smarty template engine.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard generic PHP class used for creating simple objects, such as $context and $gui.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters related to test plan and project IDs.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing the test plan planning features.
